guide.dimensionalfluxminer.cover.title: Dimensional Flux Guide
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.cover.subtitl: A manual for those who hate digging
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.cover.intro: Here live the secrets of machines that crush, smelt and make ores appear out of nothing. Read calmly and keep grandma away from the Drain.

guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.welcome: Some machines dig. This one §blistens§r. The Miner tunes into the frequency of the dimension it stands in and makes its ores appear out of nothing, without opening a single hole in the world. To get there you will rely on two allies: the §bMechanical Crusher§r and the §bElectric Furnace§r. You can put the pickaxe away. Gently, it has feelings too.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.energy: Every machine in this guide runs on §eenergy (FE)§r. This mod has no generators: power comes from other mods, and each machine's bar shows how much it has stored.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.mod_link: Open the mod page on CurseForge
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.reactor: Need power? Bigger Reactors Rework, by the same author, adds reactors and turbines that generate FE.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.path:
§b1.§r Build the Crusher and the Electric Furnace.
§b2.§r Crush iron, coal and calcite.
§b3.§r Smelt the three together and §ePure Steel§r is born.
§b4.§r With Pure Steel, forge the Reinforced Eye of Ender, the Miner parts and a core (see "Which core first?" in Running the Miner).
§b5.§r Build the Miner, hand it the core, give it power and press the button.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.interfa: The tabs on the sides of the machines open the side configuration, details, upgrade, speed and redstone. If something goes wrong, a yellow triangle appears in the corner and tells you why.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.slots: Shortcut: sneak + right click with an upgrade or core in hand installs it straight into the block.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.guide: Turn the pages with the arrows, the ←→ keys or the mouse wheel; the violet ribbon at the top goes back to the contents. Lost the book? Make another:
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.ste: §ePure Steel§r is the only metal that holds the flux: steel from other mods will not do. It comes out of the Electric Furnace, in a mode with alloys, from §eIron Dust, Coal Dust and Calcite Grains§r, and leaves a §eSlag§r as a byproduct.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.sla: Nothing goes to waste: nine slag form an Aggregate, which the Electric Furnace turns back into steel. Dimensional recycling, the planet thanks you.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.eye: An eye of ender armored with steel. It still points to strongholds but §enever breaks§r on the way. Finally, an eye that does not abandon you halfway through the trip.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.par: Twenty-seven parts form the Miner. Yes, you will need a lot of steel. Yes, it is worth it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.about: Steel jaws that grind any precious stone into grains. Keep your fingers away.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.ores: Every crushed ore gives §edouble§r the material, or §etriple§r with the Efficiency Upgrade. It works with ores of any mod. The prettiest math in Minecraft.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.dusts: Ingots, raw ores and gems become dust. Coal and calcite become the steel ingredients.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.slots: One input and four outputs. When no output has room, it stops and the outputs turn red with embarrassment.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.sides: Items dropped on top go in by themselves, so watch what you drop nearby.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.speed: From level 1 to 10 it goes from 1 item every 10 seconds up to 1 280 per second. The costs are in Speed and Upgrade.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.electric_furn: A furnace without flame: three lanes of electric heat that smelt and join metals. No coal was harmed in the making of this heat.

§bFurnace Only:§r three independent furnaces.
§bAlloy + Furnace:§r when the lanes form an alloy, it is born; otherwise each lane smelts on its own.
§bAlloy Only:§r alloys only, which sometimes leave a byproduct (like the slag of steel).
Raw ore pays more here: §e2 raw become 3 ingots§r, or §e1 becomes 2§r with the Efficiency Upgrade. Somewhere, a stone furnace is crying.
With Auto Split on, the Electric Furnace shares the items among the free lanes by itself. Fairer than most pizza splits.
Each lane has its own output. An alloy uses the first for its result and the second for the byproduct.
Recipe experience is kept as §eLiquid Experience§r (1 XP point = 20 mB): it leaves through pipes, with its own Auto Eject on the fluid tab, or spills as orbs if the machine is broken.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.intr: Twenty-seven parts, one single purpose. Drag the model to rotate it, look at one layer at a time and hover a part in the list to see where it lives. Spin it all you want, it does not get dizzy.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.laye:
§bBase:§r 7 Dimensional Ports around, a Steel Chassis in the center and the Terminal in the front middle.
§bMiddle:§r the Quantum Core at the heart; Glass in front and on both sides; Steel Chassis in the corners and at the back.
§bTop:§r Glass in the center, front and sides; Ventilation in the corners and the back middle.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.fron: The Terminal faces the front of the machine. The ports of the base have nine faces: three on each side and three at the back. In §bSide Configuration§r you pick the §bore output§r face and, with the Stabilized Core, the §bmatter§r face (they may be the same). §bEnergy§r enters through any face: a port lights up where a cable touches it, or pick the faces yourself.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.buil: Hold the Terminal and the machine shows see-through where it would be built. Place the Terminal: the missing parts stay see-through (a red outline means a block is in the way). Every click on the Terminal fits the next part from your inventory; with no part, the click hides or shows the preview.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.powe: It awakens asleep: it only works after you press the power button. Redstone can put it to sleep, never wake it. Just like everyone on a Monday.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.how: The Miner manifests the ores of the dimension it stands in, each according to its rarity. Every attempt costs §e2 DM§r and energy. Without energy, without DM or with a full output, it stops.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.basic: §bDimensional Drain:§r stretches invisible roots for 300 blocks and harvests the dimensional energy that keeps the land standing, column by column (§e64 DM§r each). The price: without that energy, the matter of the place decays and the land becomes §ccorrupted§r. Your neighbors may not love the new decor. The Nether and the End have nothing to drain.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.stabili: §bMatter Injection:§r feed the matter port with stone and ores and it turns them into DM at once. §aThe landscape stays untouched§r, and that chest full of cobblestone is finally good for something.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.matter: Every item that goes into the matter port turns into DM at once. Only matter of the dimension the Miner stands in counts: Nether stone does not get through Overworld customs.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.termina: The Terminal screen shows the machine's state, its core, what holds production back and how much DM is stored.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.buttons:
§bPower:§r wakes the machine up and puts it to sleep.
§bFilter:§r choose the ores you want; the rest returns to the void, no tears.
§bSide Configuration§r (tab on the left): the nine ports of the base.
Nothing but the Core slot works until a Core is inserted.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.output: Twenty-seven output slots. When full, the Miner stops and just stares at you. Keep it empty with pipes or Auto Eject.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.in: The dimension the Miner stands in decides which ores it manifests and which matter it accepts.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ov: Both cores work here. The §bBasic Core§r drains the energy of the land and §cDimensional Death§r spreads. The §bStabilized Core§r accepts the Overworld's stones, dirt, sand, terracotta and every ore born here.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ne: The Nether was born corrupted: there is nothing to drain, so §eonly the Stabilized Core§r works here, corrupting nothing. It accepts netherrack, basalt, blackstone, glowstone, soul sand and soil, nether bricks and the Nether's ores.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.en: In the End too, §eonly the Stabilized Core§r works, corrupting nothing. It accepts end stone, purpur and the End's ores. Where few ore families are born, §ethe void§r takes part of the attempts: 97%% with one family, about 93%%, 83%% and 58%% with two, three and four, none from five on. Those attempts still cost energy and DM.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.eg: §bDragon egg:§r you beat the dragon, put the egg on a shelf and now you look at it thinking of DM? The Miner takes it: §e10 DM§r in one go. There is no other one, there are no refunds, and the dragon, wherever it is, is judging you.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.di: These are only the best-known materials: cut and polished variants count too. Bring whatever you find to the port; the Miner knows what belongs to its place.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.or: An ore only becomes matter in the dimension where it is born, and only that variant: Overworld diamond ore does not get into the Nether, and Nether quartz does not get into the Overworld. If a mod generates that same ore in another dimension, it counts there too. This applies to the matter port and to the automatic input from chests alike.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ob: §bObsidian§r belongs to no single reality: it turns into matter in §eany dimension§r, always §e1 DM§r.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.mo: In dimensions of other mods, the Miner manifests and accepts the ores born there. Which stones of each world also count as matter? That is for explorers to find out.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ta: The value of every item is in the table of the Running the Miner chapter.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.intro: There is no speed upgrade to craft: every machine has a §bSpeed selector from 1 to 10§r (the tab with colored strips; left click goes up, right click down). The faster, the more FE/t: your power generation is the limit.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.buffer: Every operation costs the same energy at every level; a higher level only raises the speed and the FE/t in the same proportion. A machine only spends for the work it does: when idle, it spends nothing.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.miner_n: Ores and DM per second at full power. Every attempt always costs the same energy, even the ones the filter discards. The Efficiency Upgrade does not change its thirst.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.crusher: Operations/s = items crushed per second. At level 10 it goes past a thousand per second: bring pipes that can keep up.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.electri: Items per second of each of the 3 lanes for a common furnace recipe (10 s). The FE/t is that of the 3 lanes smelting; an alloy costs less. Each slot holds up to 64 items, so at level 10 the raw bonus is limited by the output.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.upgrade: One single, expensive upgrade that goes into the Upgrade tab.

§bCrusher:§r half the energy and 3 products per ore instead of 2.
§bElectric Furnace:§r half the energy and a raw bonus of 1 → 2 instead of 2 → 3.
§bMiner:§r energy unchanged; more DM from the matter port and the filter (see Running the Miner).
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.intro: The Drain takes its toll. Dimensional energy is the glue that holds the whole world together; where the Drain harvests it, the structure of the place falls apart, life withers and the land rots forever. Think twice before installing it next to grandma's house.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.terrai: Dirt, grass and stone darken, terracotta becomes §eCorrupted Terracotta§r and sand and gravel become §eCorrupted Sediment§r. Dimensional Death reaches through trees and buildings, and flowers turn into wither roses. A lovely gift for people you do not like.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.water: Water touched by Dimensional Death turns purple and sinks, corrupting the water below it, layer by layer. No land plant drinks from it; only sea life endures. No, it is not grape juice.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.creatu: Corrupted water hurts players and peaceful creatures but is a balm for hostile ones. You would not want to face a drowned bathed in it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.avoid: Want to mine without hurting the land? The Stabilized Dimensional Core never touches the environment. The server's environmentalists approve.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.matter_: §bOres§r only count in the dimension where they are born: §e0.5 DM§r each; diamond and uranium §e1 DM§r; emerald, platinum and ancient debris §e2 DM§r (with the upgrade up to +0.2, but an ore never gives more than the 2 DM it costs to make).

§bWith the Efficiency Upgrade§r, every injected item gives §e+0.2 DM§r on top of its value, or double its value when it is worth less (the last column of the table). On top of that, the ores the filter would discard are not lost: they come back as DM (up to 2 DM each).
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.electric_furn:
Use both machines together and every ore gives far more than the 1 ingot of a common furnace:
§bNo upgrades:§r 1 ore → 2 raw → §e3 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in the Crusher only:§r 1 ore → 3 raw → §e4.5 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in the Electric Furnace only:§r 1 ore → 2 raw → §e4 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in both:§r 1 ore → 3 raw → §e6 ingots§r.
This applies to ores that become raw ore, like iron, gold and copper.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.breakin: When a machine is broken, §eall its items§r drop, core and upgrade included. The §estored energy§r, the work in progress and the Miner's §eDM§r are lost, and its settings do not travel with the block. The Electric Furnace drops its stored experience as orbs.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.electric_furn: In the modes with alloys, the Side Configuration gets three more colors: §6Input 1§r, §eInput 2§r and §dInput 3§r. A face with one of them sends everything to that lane only, so each alloy ingredient can arrive through its own pipe. The plain §cInput§r still shares between the three.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.compare: §bWhich core first?§r The §bBasic§r one is cheaper and feeds itself, but only finds something to drain in the Overworld and corrupts the area. The §bStabilized§r one works in any dimension and never touches the landscape, but you have to feed it matter. Many start with the Basic core far from home and move to the Stabilized one later.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.loaded: The Drain only reaches §eloaded chunks§r. If you walk away, or without a chunk loader, it stops harvesting and the Miner runs out of DM.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.filter: Mark only the ore families you want; with nothing marked, it keeps everything. The search box finds an ore by name or tag (right click clears it). The filter does not change the odds: a discarded attempt still costs energy and DM.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ba: On barren planets and desolate worlds of other mods, the land holds no energy worth harvesting: the §bBasic Core§r finds nothing to drain and only the §bStabilized§r one works. Each world has its own stones, and they are matter only there.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.protec: Dimensional Death respects borders. Claimed land is only corrupted if the Miner's owner may build there; the spawn protection and the regions the server protects are never touched, and Corrupted Water does not cross those borders. It also never hydrates farmland or sugar cane.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.in: Everything that connects the machines to the rest of your base.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.si: The tab with the faces icon, at the top left, opens the Side Configuration. Each material (items, energy, fluids) has its own tab. Left click on a face picks the next role, right click goes back. The batch button sets every face to the same role; with Shift, it clears everything.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.co: §cRed:§r item input. §6Orange§r, §eyellow§r and §dpink:§r the Electric Furnace's Inputs 1, 2 and 3 in the modes with alloys. §9Blue:§r output. §5Purple:§r input and output on the same face. §bLight blue:§r energy. §aGreen:§r Liquid Experience output.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.au: §bAuto Input§r pulls from neighboring inventories through the input faces; §bAuto Eject§r pushes through the output faces. Each material has its own pair of switches at the top of the Side Configuration; Liquid Experience only has Auto Eject. Pipes of other mods work through the configured faces even with everything off.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.re: On the Crusher and the Electric Furnace, the redstone tab has three modes: §bIgnored§r (always works), §bNormal§r (only with a signal) and §bInverted§r (only without one). On the Miner, Redstone Control needs a signal on one of the nine bottom blocks, but never starts a machine stopped with its button.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.automation.ca: A cable or pipe that keeps §epulling§r items from a face gets an §bOutput§r there, and one that keeps §epushing§r gets an §cInput§r (on the Miner's ports, the §bMatter Input§r, with the Stabilized Core). What the face already did is kept. The face stays locked while the cable works and unlocks a few seconds after it stops.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.about: The §bDimensional Tank§r holds §e128 000 mB§r of one liquid and, for once, asks for no energy at all. Its trick: every tank with the same code, in any dimension, is the same tank. Fill one at home, drain the other in the Nether. Plumbers hate it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.dual: Two separate chambers of §e128 000 mB§r each, for two different liquids: §bA§r on the right of the front and §bB§r on the left. A full chamber never spills into the other one, and dual tanks with the same code share A with A and B with B.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.code: The three colors on the front panel (repeated on the lid) are the tank's address. Click the code on the screen, choose a position, then one of the 16 colors. §eThe order counts§r: red, blue, white is not blue, red, white. A new tank comes with its channel locked; unlock it with the padlock (Shift + click) to use the code, which starts on white, white, white.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.code_ch: Changing the code moves no liquid: the tank just points at another channel, and the liquid it had waits there for any tank with the old code. §eSingle and dual tanks never share a channel§r, even with the same colors.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.clear: Put a liquid you do not want in a channel? The §bEmpty§r button in the code window (one per chamber on the dual tank) deletes it for every tank with that code. Click it twice to confirm.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.persona: Use a §bdiamond§r on the tank (or click the code window's button with one on the cursor) and the code becomes §bpersonal§r: a channel of its own for you, apart from the public one with the same colors. Sneak and use the tank with an empty hand to make it public again; the diamond comes back.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.buckets: Right click the tank with a full bucket (or any fluid container) to empty it inside, with an empty one to take liquid out; it also works while sneaking. On the dual tank the side you click picks the chamber: the right side is A, the left side B. On the screen, click the reservoir with the container on the cursor.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.bucket_: Used on another tank, the Dimensional Tank item (and the creative one) fills it with as much of its channel's liquid as fits. It also works as a bucket: sneak and use it in the air to turn §bbucket mode§r on, and it pours the liquid on the ground one bucket at a time (sneaking always pours) and picks up the liquid source you look at.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.pipes: Every face except the front connects to pipes, already as input and output. The §bLiquids§r tab of the Side Configuration chooses what each face does and has its own §bAuto Input§r and §bAuto Eject§r, with no speed limit. While Auto Eject is on, an input and output face only gives, so pipe networks do not send the liquid back.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.pipes_d: On the dual tank each face serves one chamber only: §cred§r, §9blue§r and §5purple§r are the input, output and both of A; §6orange§r, §3cyan§r and §eyellow§r those of B. The right side starts with A and the left side with B.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.display: The liquid shows through the glass, and the gauge beside it fills with the liquid's color. On the dual tank, the two stripes on the lid show the liquids of A and B (gray when empty), and the code panel sits between them.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.break: Shared liquid stays in its channel when a tank breaks. The item keeps its code, channel mode and individual reserve, so placing it again restores both modes without moving liquid between them.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.creativ: Creative mode only, for building and testing. It comes filled with any liquid of the game, and an empty one adopts the first liquid it receives. Its liquid §enever runs out§r and, empty, it voids whatever pipes send. It has no channels. Sneak and use it with an empty hand, or the button on its screen, to empty it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.intro: Every stopped machine has a reason, and it always tells you. On the Miner, the Terminal screen shows the state in big letters and the §bLIMIT§r line says what holds production back. On the Crusher and the Electric Furnace, hover the yellow triangle in the corner.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.miner:
§bMULTIBLOCK INVALID:§r a part is missing or in the wrong place. Click the Terminal to see the preview.
§bCORE REQUIRED:§r insert a core.
§bMANUAL STOP:§r press the power button.
§bREDSTONE HALT:§r Redstone Control is on and the base has no signal.
§bOUTPUT BLOCKED:§r the output is full; empty it with pipes or Auto Eject.
§bWAITING FOR ENERGY:§r not enough FE; check the cables or lower the speed.
§bWAITING FOR MATTER:§r the Stabilized core has no DM; feed the matter port with matter of this dimension.
§bNO DRAINABLE MATTER:§r the Basic core finds nothing to drain: a lifeless dimension, everything already corrupted, protected land or unloaded chunks.
§bDIMENSIONAL SURVEY:§r the Basic core is mapping the land; wait a moment.
§bNO RESOURCES IN THIS DIMENSION:§r the dimension generates no known ore.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.machi:
§bNO INPUT:§r nothing to process.
§bNO RECIPE:§r the item has no recipe here; on the Electric Furnace, check the mode and that every busy lane is part of the alloy.
§bOUTPUT BLOCKED:§r the outputs are full.
§bWAITING FOR ENERGY / LOW ENERGY:§r less FE arrives than the speed level asks for.
§bREDSTONE HALT:§r the redstone mode is blocking it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.trouble.energ: Low energy is almost always solved by lowering the speed level to what your generation can hold. The machine never works for free: with little FE it just goes slower.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.root.d: Some machines dig. This one listens.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.crushe: Build a Mechanical Crusher. The stones of the world are already nervous.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.electr: Build an Electric Furnace. The stone furnace is already updating its résumé.
Forge your first Pure Steel. Tough as nails, literally. The Flux Guide comes as a gift.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.slag_r: Turn Slag Aggregate back into steel. Even leftovers deserve a second chance.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.reinfo: Give the eye of ender a suit of steel armor. It had it coming.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.strong: Finally, an eye that does not abandon you halfway through the trip.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.miner_: Twenty-seven parts and no screws left over. A miracle!
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.first_: An ore that sprouted out of nowhere, and not a single pickaxe involved.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.ore_fi: Use the Miner filter. That ore failed the job interview.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.max_sp: Speed 10 for 10 seconds straight. Your power bill sends its regards.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.thousa: Over a thousand operations per second, for 5 seconds in a row. The server is breaking a sweat.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.effici: It cost a dragon, an enchanted apple and a piece of your soul.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.matter: Mining without making a mess: cobblestone goes in, matter comes out, and nature never notices.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.trash_: Turn 10 000 cobblestone into Dimensional Matter. Finally a use for that pile of cobblestone.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.column: The first column drained. The land felt it, and did not like it.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.scorch: Step on corrupted dirt. That is not fertilizer.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.purple: A dip in corrupted water: refreshing, purple and mildly deadly.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.warden: Saw a Warden healing in corrupted water? It will not thank you. Run.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.world_: Half of the whole area around the Miner drained to the last drop. The cartographer quit.
tag.entity_type.dimensionalfluxminer.cor: Healed a heart by Corrupted Water

guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.contain: The single tank has two container slots: the red one empties into the tank and the blue one fills from it. Each holds one container and returns the result in the same slot after a short delay; pipes take out the finished ones. In Side Configuration, pick input, output or both for each slot.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.convers: The blue slot also wets sponges and hardens all colors of concrete powder with water. The red slot dries wet sponges and stores their water. Experience bottles accept common experience fluids. Emptying one adds to existing tagged XP; an empty tank receives this mod's Liquid Experience.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.bottles: A Glass Bottle and 250 mB of Liquid Experience make a Bottle o’ Enchanting. The red slot reverses the conversion, returning the bottle and 250 mB.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.tanks.local: With the channel locked (Shift + click the padlock), the tank works on its own: the colors go inactive and an amber padlock shows on the front and lid. The channel's liquid stays in the channel; the individual liquid stays in this tank, even when unlocked or broken. Shift + click again to reconnect.
